# Description
This project explores daily air quality measurements collected from the EPA monitoring station at RDU airport. The analysis focuses on carbon monoxide (CO), fine particulate matter (PM2.5), and ozone (O3) concentrations from 2018 through April 2020. The goal is to clean the raw data, summarize pollutant concentrations, and explore monthly and seasonal patterns using tables and visualizations.

```{r}

# Load in libraries
library(tidyverse) #version 2.0.0
library(gt) #version 1.3.0
library(lubridate) #version 1.9.4
```

```{r}
# Cleans air quality data by keeping date and pollutant concentration variables,
# converting dates, removing duplicate observations, replacing negative
# measurements with zero, and averaging multiple measurements taken on the same day.
#
# Arguments:
#   file: Path to the CSV file containing air quality data.
#   ozone_units: Desired units for ozone concentration ("ppm" or "ppb").
#                Defaults to "ppm".
#
# Returns:
#   A cleaned data frame with one row per date and columns for CO, PM2.5,
#   and O3 concentrations. O3 is returned in the units specified by ozone_units.

clean_pollution = function(file, ozone_units = "ppm") {
  # Read in data
  AQ = read.csv(file)

  # Keep only date and pollutant concentrations
  AQ = AQ[, c(1, 2, 4, 6)]

  # Rename columns with consistent internal names
  names(AQ) = c("date", "co", "pm25", "o3")

  # Convert date variable to an actual R Date object
  AQ$date = as.Date(AQ$date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

  # Remove duplicate rows
  AQ = distinct(AQ)

  # Loop through pollutant measurement columns and replace negative values with 0
  pollutants = c("co", "pm25", "o3")
  for (i in pollutants) {
    AQ[[i]][AQ[[i]] < 0] = 0
  }

  # Average days where multiple measurements are taken
  AQ = AQ |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarize(
      co = mean(co, na.rm = TRUE),
      pm25 = mean(pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
      o3 = mean(o3, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  # Convert O3 units from ppm to ppb if requested
  if (ozone_units == "ppb") {
    AQ$o3 = AQ$o3 * 1000
  }

  # Rename columns to their final descriptive names
  if (ozone_units == "ppm") {
    names(AQ) = c("date", "co_8hr_max_ppm", "pm25_daily_mean_ugm3", "o3_8hr_max_ppm")
  } else {
    names(AQ) = c("date", "co_8hr_max_ppm", "pm25_daily_mean_ugm3", "o3_8hr_max_ppb")
  }

  return(AQ)
}
```


```{r, include = FALSE}
# Testing function
AQ2018 = clean_pollution("data-7/data/AQ_2018.csv")
AQ2018_ppb = clean_pollution("data-7/data/AQ_2018.csv", ozone_units = "ppb")
AQ2019 = clean_pollution("data-7/data/AQ_2019.csv")
AQ2019_ppb = clean_pollution("data-7/data/AQ_2019.csv", ozone_units = "ppb")
AQ2020 = clean_pollution("data-7/data/AQ_2020.csv")
AQ2020_ppb = clean_pollution("data-7/data/AQ_2020.csv", ozone_units = "ppb")

# Check for duplicate dates
anyDuplicated(AQ2020$date)

# Check for negative pollutant measurements
any(AQ2020[, -1] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# Combine datasets
AQ_all = bind_rows(AQ2018, AQ2019, AQ2020)
```

# Tables

&nbsp;

```{r}
# Calculate minimum and maximum daily pollutant concentrations
table2018 = bind_rows(
  # Calculate minimum concentrations
  AQ2018 |>
    summarize(
      Statistic = "Minimum",
      co_8hr_max_ppm = min(co_8hr_max_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
      pm25_daily_mean_ugm3 = min(pm25_daily_mean_ugm3, na.rm = TRUE),
      o3_8hr_max_ppm = min(o3_8hr_max_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),

  # Calculate maximum concentrations
  AQ2018 |>
    summarize(
      Statistic = "Maximum",
      co_8hr_max_ppm = max(co_8hr_max_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
      pm25_daily_mean_ugm3 = max(pm25_daily_mean_ugm3, na.rm = TRUE),
      o3_8hr_max_ppm = max(o3_8hr_max_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)

# Format the summary data as a table
table2018 = table2018 |>
  gt() |>

  # Add descriptive column labels and units
  cols_label(
    Statistic = "Statistic",
    co_8hr_max_ppm = "CO (ppm)",
    pm25_daily_mean_ugm3 = "PM2.5 (µg/m³)",
    o3_8hr_max_ppm = "O3 (ppm)"
  ) |>

  # Display pollutant concentrations to three decimal places
  fmt_number(
    columns = -Statistic,
    decimals = 3
  ) |>

  # Add an informative table title
  tab_header(
    title = "Daily Air Pollutant Concentrations: 2018"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "center"),
    locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
  )

table2018
```

# Plots

&nbsp;

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Extract month from date
AQ_all = AQ_all |>
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE))

# Calculate monthly means and 95% confidence intervals
monthly_summary = AQ_all |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    # CO statistics
    co_mean = mean(co_8hr_max_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    co_sd = sd(co_8hr_max_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    co_n = sum(!is.na(co_8hr_max_ppm)),
    co_lower = co_mean - 1.96 * co_sd / sqrt(co_n),
    co_upper = co_mean + 1.96 * co_sd / sqrt(co_n),

    # O3 statistics
    o3_mean = mean(o3_8hr_max_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    o3_sd = sd(o3_8hr_max_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    o3_n = sum(!is.na(o3_8hr_max_ppm)),
    o3_lower = o3_mean - 1.96 * o3_sd / sqrt(o3_n),
    o3_upper = o3_mean + 1.96 * o3_sd / sqrt(o3_n)
  )

monthly_summary

# Rescale O3 means and confidence intervals for plotting
monthly_plot_data = monthly_summary |>
  mutate(
    o3_mean_scaled = o3_mean * 10,
    o3_lower_scaled = o3_lower * 10,
    o3_upper_scaled = o3_upper * 10
  )

monthly_plot_data
```


```{r}
# Plot monthly CO and O3 means with 95% confidence intervals
ggplot(monthly_plot_data, aes(x = month)) +

  # Add CO monthly means and 95% confidence intervals
  geom_point(aes(y = co_mean, color = "CO"), size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = co_lower, ymax = co_upper, color = "CO"),
    width = 0.2
  ) +

  # Add scaled O3 monthly means and 95% confidence intervals
  geom_point(aes(y = o3_mean_scaled, color = "O3"), size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = o3_lower_scaled, ymax = o3_upper_scaled, color = "O3"),
    width = 0.2
  ) +

  # Set colors and create the pollutant legend
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Pollutant",
    breaks = c("CO", "O3"),
    values = c("CO" = "#0072B2", "O3" = "#D55E00")
  ) +

  # Abbreviate month names on the x-axis
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
               "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")
  ) +

  # Add plot title, axis labels, and scaling note
  labs(
    title = "Monthly CO and O3 Concentrations",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Mean Concentration (ppm)",
    caption = "Note: O3 concentrations and 95% confidence intervals were multiplied by 10 for comparison."
  ) +

  # Apply a minimal theme and format month labels
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 0,
      size = 8,
      margin = margin(t = 5)
    ),
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 25, l = 10)
  )
```
  
I decided to scale the O3 variable by 10 so that its measurements were similar to those of the CO variable. Having similar measurement scales makes comparisons and relationships easier to see.

&nbsp;

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Calculate monthly mean PM2.5 concentration for each year
monthly_pm25_summary = AQ_all |>
  mutate(
    year = format(date, "%Y"),
    month = factor(format(date, "%b"), levels = month.abb)
  ) |>
  group_by(year, month) |>
  summarize(
    pm25_mean = mean(pm25_daily_mean_ugm3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(year, month)

monthly_pm25_summary
```

```{r}
# Plot monthly PM2.5 concentrations by year
ggplot(monthly_pm25_summary, aes(x = month, y = pm25_mean, color = year, group = year)) +

  # Connect monthly means for each year
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +

  # Add points for individual monthly means
  geom_point(size = 2) +

  # Set colors and create the year legend
  scale_color_brewer(
    name = "Year",
    palette = "Dark2"
  ) +

  # Add plot title and axis labels
  labs(
    title = "Monthly PM2.5 Concentrations by Year",
    x = "Month",
    y = expression("Mean PM2.5 Concentration ("*mu*"g/m"^3*")")
  ) +

  # Apply minimal theme
  theme_minimal()
```
  
A line graph was chosen to illustrate changes in monthly PM2.5 concentrations throughout the year and allow for comparisons of seasonal patterns across years.  

&nbsp;
  
## Interpretation
From the graphs, I see seasonal patterns in CO and O3 concentrations. CO decreases during the warmer months and increases during the colder months, while the opposite appears to be true for O3. It is harder to identify a clear pattern for PM2.5 because the line graph appears more sporadic. More data would likely be needed to determine whether there is a consistent seasonal pattern.
